protocol.split: StratifiedGroupKFold 5 folds; fold0 test, fold1 calibration, folds2-4 train. Stratified on original3 labels.
protocol.grouping: NFKC lowercase whitespace dedup; zero-width removed; URL/email/digit-masked word templates; word-trigram Jaccard>=0.8 for >=6words; connected components. Approximate templates, not verified campaigns.
protocol.selection: Fixed model/hyperparameters before test evaluation. Lexical model deployed for browser size and local inference, not selected by test score.
